variants.name: Deployed
variants.summary: The deployed version, read-only: the creation date beside the Deployed Tag, the settings fieldset disabled, and the version bar reading Viewing a deployed version and Read-only with its description, Add Version and Redeploy.

variants.name: VersionHistory
variants.summary: The draft with Version history open beside it: the current version with its description, author and the pencil that edits it in place, the empty changes entry, and the five newest earlier versions with Show older for the rest.

variants.name: Revert
variants.summary: An earlier Ready version opened from Version history, read-only, the history pane open with the entry marked Viewing. The version bar reads Viewing an earlier version and offers Add Version and a primary Revert to AK7D0ZX4, which opens a `ConfirmDialog` with the diff against the deployed version: each changed setting from its old value to the new one, the rules added and removed, and that the deployed version stays in history. Confirm runs the revert as an async action: one toast turns from Reverting to AK7D0ZX4… into the outcome with Edit and Redeploy, and the version's Tag becomes Deployed.

variants.name: EnvironmentCrumb
variants.summary: The same version page reached from an environment: the trail reads Resources, the resource, then two `Select` crumbs (the page's `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs` from md up, the body's own row below md). The environment crumb searches the environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; picking one moves the version crumb to the version that environment serves. The version crumb marks each version with the environments it is live in, beside its state `Tag`.

variants.name: Creating
variants.summary: A new version being copied from the deployed AEO25I38: the workspace is drawn as `Skeleton` wires (a heading band, then sectioned cards of rows with a trailing switch) inside a polite busy status, and the version bar shows a `Spinner`, reads Creating new version… and Copying AEO25I38 into a new draft., with Add Version loading and Redeploy disabled.

variants.name: NotFound
variants.summary: A version link that points nowhere: the trail ends on the missing version and the body is a bordered `EmptyState`, Version not found, saying the version may have been deleted, with View Versions back to the Versions tab.

variants.name: Source
variants.summary: The draft on its Source tab: a small Source heading with Upload Files, the controls row (search in folder, Refresh, Download CSV, Columns and Open in Object Storage), a `Breadcrumb` of the folder path from the bucket, and the files table whose folders open in place and whose empty state offers Upload Files and Open Bucket.

variants.name: DeviceGroups
variants.summary: The draft on its Device Groups tab: a small heading with Add Device Group, the controls row and the groups table (name, User-Agent match, last modified). A name opens the edit `Drawer`, the same one Add Device Group opens, with the Name and the User-Agent regular expression `Textarea`, validated on submit.

variants.name: CacheSettings
variants.summary: The draft on its Cache Settings tab: the cache settings table (browser cache, edge cache, a tiered cache `Tag`, last modified) and the add or edit `Drawer` that holds the cache-settings rows of Templates/Platform/Edit/EditResource: Browser cache, Edge cache with stale, large file and tiered cache, and a collapsible Advanced cache key that ends on Adaptive delivery and a Device groups `MultiSelect`.

variants.name: FunctionsInstances
variants.summary: The draft on its Functions Instances tab: the instances table with the runtime glyph and a link to each function, its arguments and status, and the add or edit `Drawer` with the Name, a function `Select` whose footer is Create Function, and the arguments as a `SchemaForm` when the function declares a schema or a JSON `CodeEditor` when it does not.

guidelines:
# Version detail

One version of a resource, opened from its Versions tab. The user is here to change a draft and ship it, or to read what a built version holds and redeploy it or branch a new version from it. The page keeps the version they are on in the breadcrumb, where they can switch to another, puts the version's settings in tabs, pins the state and the save or deploy action to the bottom, and opens the version history beside the work when they need to see what changed. It is a page body for `ConsoleLayout`: the app renders it in the layout's default slot, and the layout owns the rail, the header with the breadcrumb, the ⌘K palette and the `main`. The workspace pins its own bars, so its root carries `data-layout-fill`: the layout's `main` stops scrolling, the root fills it (`h-dvh` only sizes a standalone preview) and its panes scroll.

## When to use

- A resource whose configuration is versioned: drafts are edited, built and deployed, and built versions are read-only.
- The user opens a row of the Versions tab of `platform/detail/details-page`, or creates a new version.
- The version has several areas of settings (Settings, Source, Device Groups, Cache Settings, Functions Instances, Rules Engine) that share one save and deploy action.

## When not to use

- The overview of the resource itself, its domains and deployments: use `platform/detail/details-page`.
- A resource without versions whose settings save in place: use `platform/edit/edit-resource` or `platform/settings/settings-form`.
- The Rules Engine tab content: use `platform/edit/rule-builder`.
- Deploying from a list without opening a version: use `platform/create/deploy-drawer`.

## Building blocks

### A. Version switcher — `ConsoleLayout`, `Select`, `Input`, `Tag`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip` (required)

The page sets the trail with `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs`: `items` are the module and the resource, and the slot holds the version, a `Select` with `kind="transparent"`, `size="small"` and `aria-label="Switch version"`, no `w-full`. The version is part of the route, so picking one navigates. Its content has a small search `Input`, a Versions group where each option carries its state `Tag` (Draft, Deployed, Ready), a no-match line, and a footer option that creates a new version. The version is never a page title.

The layout hides its breadcrumbs while compact, so the body opens on a row (`md:hidden`, its own `nav` named Breadcrumb) that carries a Back `IconButton` to the resource's Versions tab and the same `Select` crumbs, full width: the version, and in EnvironmentCrumb the environment before it. A phone keeps every switch the desktop breadcrumb offers.

### B. Workspace — `Resizable` (required)

A horizontal `Resizable` named "Version workspace": the version settings pane, a handle named "Resize the version history", and the collapsible Version history pane. History is closed by default.

### C. Version tab bar — `PageTabs`, `Tabs`, `Tag`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton`, `EmptyState` (required)

`PageTabs` with one `Tabs.Item` per area: Settings, Source, Device Groups, Cache Settings, Functions Instances, Rules Engine. The tab row ends on the version's state `Tag` and an outlined Version actions `IconButton` whose `DropdownMenu` holds Edit version info and the toggle for Version history. Each tab is its own route: a variant renders the open tab's panel, and a tab whose panel lives on another route shows an `EmptyState` with an Open link to it.

### D. Settings panel — `ScrollArea`, `PageHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `Card`, `Item`, `SettingRow`, `Input`, `Switch`, `Tooltip` (required)

The open tab scrolls in a fading `ScrollArea`. A small `PageHeader` names the tab, then `SettingsSection`s (General, Modules, Subscription modules) each hold a `Card :padded="false"` with an `Item.List` of `SettingRow`s: a title, a one-sentence description and its control, an `Input` or a `Switch`. A module that needs a sales contact keeps its `Switch` disabled, explained by a `Tooltip`. On a built version the whole fieldset is disabled.

### E. Version bar — `Tag`, `SplitButton`, `Button` (required)

A bar pinned to the bottom of the settings pane, aligned with the column above it. It names the state with a `Tag` and one sentence. On a draft it holds a primary medium `SplitButton` that saves and deploys, with Save and build and Save in its menu. On a built version it reads Viewing a deployed version with a Read-only tag and offers Add Version and Redeploy.

### F. Version history — `IconButton`, `Tag`, `Field`, `Textarea`, `Button`, `Avatar` (optional)

The side pane titled "Version history", closed with an `IconButton`. It starts on the current version with its `Tag`, its description, its author `Avatar` and a pencil that edits the description in place through a `Field` with a `Textarea` and Cancel and Save `Button`s. Then the changes entry, empty until something is saved, then the five newest earlier versions and Show older for the rest. Each earlier version is a link to that version's page, never a button; the one being viewed carries `aria-current="page"`.

### G. Revert — `Button`, `Tag` (optional, on an earlier Ready version)

An earlier version opened from Version history keeps the page read-only and says Viewing an earlier version, with the entry in history marked by a Viewing `Tag` and `aria-current="page"`. The version bar's primary action is Revert to <id>, the trigger of a `ConfirmDialog` with `kind="primary"` and `size="medium"`. Its body is the diff against the deployed version: a bordered list of the settings that change, each with its old and new value in words, a line with the rules added and removed, and a description saying that reverting deploys <id> to Production and that the deployed version stays in history. Confirm closes the dialog and starts the async-submit run: one toast id that turns from a loading toast ("Reverting to <id>…", "It keeps running if you leave.") into the outcome, which stays until closed and carries **Edit** and **Redeploy**, never View deployments. On success the version's `Tag` reads Deployed in the breadcrumb, the tab row and the history, and the bar offers Redeploy.

## List tabs

Source, Device Groups, Cache Settings and Functions Instances are lists inside the version: a small `PageHeader` with an outlined add action, the controls row of `platform/view/table-view` (search, Refresh, Download CSV, Columns) and a flush `DataTable` in a `Card`, paginated at 10. Its `#empty` slot tells a search that matches nothing (No matching, with Clear search) apart from a list with nothing yet (the add action). The name cell is a button that opens the edit `Drawer`, the same drawer the add action opens, built as in `platform/create/create-in-drawer`: `SettingsSection`s of `Field`s (Device Groups, Functions Instances) or of `SettingRow`s in a `Card` (Cache Settings, reusing the rows of `platform/edit/edit-resource#CacheSettings` plus Adaptive delivery and a Device groups `MultiSelect`). Functions Instances renders the arguments as a `SchemaForm` when the function declares a schema and as a JSON `CodeEditor` when it does not, and its function `Select` ends on Create Function. Source embeds the file browser: Upload Files in the heading, Open in Object Storage in the controls row, the folder path as a `Breadcrumb` and an `EmptyState` with Upload Files and Open Bucket. Saving a drawer changes the draft only; the version bar still deploys it.

## Creating and not found

While Add Version copies a built version into a new draft, the workspace is drawn as `Skeleton` wires in a busy status region named "Creating a new version from <id>." and the version bar shows a `Spinner`, "Creating new version…", the copy line, Add Version loading and Redeploy disabled. A version link that points nowhere keeps the trail and renders a bordered `EmptyState` with View Versions.

## Do

- Keep one primary action on the page, in the version bar; the tabs share it.
- Lock the settings fieldset, not each control one by one, when the version is built.
- Let the user switch versions from the breadcrumb without going back to the list.
- Set the trail from the page with `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs`, and mark the root with `data-layout-fill`.
- Show the state in three places that agree: the breadcrumb option, the tab row tag and the version bar.
- Keep the history pane collapsible and resizable so the settings keep their width when it is closed.
- Show what a revert changes before it runs: the settings with old and new values, and the rules added and removed.
- Report a revert like any deploy: one toast that turns into the outcome, with Edit and Redeploy.
- Raise toasts with `toast` only; the app mounts the one toast region (`ToastPlugin`, or one `Toaster` at its root, as `shells/console` does), so this page body never renders a `Toaster`.

## Don't

- Don't let a built version look editable; disable the fieldset and say Read-only.
- Don't size the body with `calc(100dvh - …)`.
- Don't put Save or Deploy in the tab row or the page header.
- Don't name a tab in the breadcrumb.
- Don't list every earlier version at once; show five and Show older.
- Don't save a description edit without Cancel and Save buttons.
- Don't edit a list row in place or on a new page; open the drawer, and let the version bar deploy.
- Don't show the settings form while a new version is still being copied; draw the wires.
- Don't revert without a confirmation, and don't make the diff depend on an arrow glyph or color alone.
- Don't delete or hide the version a revert replaces; it stays in history.
- Don't offer View deployments on the revert toast.

## Copy

- **Version state tags:** one word, e.g. "Draft", "Deployed", "Ready", "Editable", "Read-only".
- **Version bar:** one sentence on what the user can do, e.g. "This version is open for editing. Deploy it when ready." or "Viewing a deployed version".
- **Save actions:** verb first, three words or fewer, e.g. "Save and deploy", "Save and build", "Save".
- **Built version actions:** "Add Version", "Redeploy"; on an earlier version "Revert to <id>".
- **Revert:** bar "Viewing an earlier version"; dialog title "Revert to <id>?", description "Reverting deploys <id> to Production in place of <deployed>. <deployed> stays in the version history, so you can redeploy it later."; diff heading "What changes against <deployed>"; toasts "Reverting to <id>…" then "<id> is deployed.", actions "Edit" and "Redeploy".
- **List tabs:** add actions name the object, e.g. "Add Device Group", "Add Cache Settings", "Add Functions Instance"; drawer titles "Add …" or "Edit …"; success toasts "Device group \"mobile\" saved." with "The change is part of this draft until you deploy it."
- **Creating and not found:** "Creating new version…", "Copying <id> into a new draft."; "Version not found" with "View Versions".
- **Version picker:** search placeholder "Search versions", no-match line `No versions match "<query>".`, footer "Add Version".
- **Setting rows:** a noun title and one sentence with a period, e.g. "Active" with "When disabled, the resource stops serving traffic."
- **History:** "Current version", an empty changes line, e.g. "No changes yet. Each change you save shows up here.", description placeholder "What changed in this version?".
- Follow `skills/webkit-microcopy`: sentence case, no em dash, no "please", no exclamation marks.

## Accessibility

- The body renders no `main`: the layout's single `main` holds the workspace; the Settings `PageHeader` title is its heading, and the history pane is a region labelled by its "Version history" `h2`.
- The resize handle has an `aria-label` and works with arrow keys.
- The version `Select` trigger is named "Switch version"; its search input is named "Search versions".
- Every `Switch` and `Input` in a setting row has an `aria-label` that matches the row title.
- A disabled control with a reason gets a `Tooltip` that the keyboard can reach.
- The revert dialog traps focus, is named by its title and returns focus to Revert on close. Each changed setting carries a visually hidden sentence ("changes from On to Off"); the struck-through values and the arrow are `aria-hidden`. The toasts live in the app's one `Toaster` region (the app mounts it; the page body only calls `toast`), and the bar's status line announces "Reverting to <id>…".
- Icon-only buttons (Version actions, Close version history, Edit version info) have an `aria-label`; decorative icons are `aria-hidden`.

## States

- Draft: the editable draft on its Settings tab, with the Editable tag and the Save and deploy split button in the version bar.
- Deployed: the deployed version, read-only, the fieldset disabled and the version bar offering Add Version and Redeploy.
- Revert: an earlier Ready version, read-only, with history open, Revert to <id> in the bar, a confirmation with the diff, and the revert reported by a toast with Edit and Redeploy.
- VersionHistory: the draft with Version history open beside it, the current version, the empty changes entry and the five newest earlier versions.
- EnvironmentCrumb: a resource that is deployed to several environments. The page's `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs` ends on two control crumbs, environment then version, each a small transparent `Select` with a search field (`Switch environment`, `Switch version`). Environments carry their deployment policy as a `Tag` and Add Environment in the footer; picking an environment moves the version crumb to the version live there, and each version option says where it is live (Live in Production). The environment always comes before the version, because a version is chosen within an environment.
- Creating: Add Version copying AEO25I38 into a new draft, the workspace as `Skeleton` wires and the version bar busy.
- NotFound: a version that does not exist, a bordered `EmptyState` with View Versions.
- Source: the draft on its Source tab, the file list of the version bucket with its folder path and Open in Object Storage.
- DeviceGroups: the draft on its Device Groups tab, the groups table and the add or edit drawer with the User-Agent expression.
- CacheSettings: the draft on its Cache Settings tab, the cache settings table and the add or edit drawer with Adaptive delivery and Device groups.
- FunctionsInstances: the draft on its Functions Instances tab, the instances table and the add or edit drawer with the function `Select` and its arguments.

## Related

- `platform/detail/details-page` — its Versions tab lists the versions that open here.
- `platform/edit/rule-builder` — the content of the Rules Engine tab.
- `platform/view/file-browser` — the full storage page the Source tab embeds.
- `platform/edit/edit-resource` — its CacheSettings variant holds the rows the Cache Settings drawer reuses.
- `platform/create/create-in-drawer` — the add and edit drawers of the list tabs.
- `platform/states/page-wires` — the skeleton wires Creating draws.
- `platform/create/deploy-drawer` — deploying a version outside this page.
- `platform/states/async-submit` — how the version bar locks while Save and deploy runs.
- `SettingRow` — the row primitive of every settings section; see `skills/webkit-form` and `skills/webkit-layout`.
